description: This Java class, DefaultLimitsConfig, implements the LimitsConfig interface and provides configuration for various size limits (such as headers, things, policies, messages) within the Eclipse Ditto project. It reads configuration values from a Config object, with support for fallback mechanisms, and exposes getter methods for these limits. Also implements WithConfigPath for configuration path identification.

classes.name: DefaultLimitsConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing LimitsConfig, encapsulates size limits configuration for the system and provides accessors for these values.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance of DefaultLimitsConfig from a given Config object, applying fallback logic and validation.

methods.name: getHeadersMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for headers.

methods.name: getAuthSubjectsMaxCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of authentication subjects.

methods.name: getPoliciesMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for policies.

methods.name: getMessagesMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for messages.

methods.name: getThingsSearchDefaultPageSize

methods.description: Returns the maximum page size for things search.
